title: Inject analyticsServiceProvider into MarkLiveCompletionUseCase so tutor_live_mark_blocked actually fires
why: grep -rn 'MarkLiveCompletionUseCase<' across lib/ shows text_display_screen.dart:669 is the ONLY production construction site in the app, and it omits the optional `analytics:` argument, so `_analytics` stays null and the null-aware `_analytics?.logEvent(...)` silently no-ops. The use case's own comment says this telemetry exists so 'tutor boundary violations are visible in dashboards' (W7.11) — the permission guard itself still works (exception thrown, dialog shown), but that dashboard signal never fires anywhere in production, so ops has zero visibility into how often the tutor write-boundary is hit.
recommendation: Pass analytics: ref.read(analyticsServiceProvider) at the construction site — the provider already exists and is used the same way by sibling tutoring providers (tutor_grant_providers.dart).
acceptance_criteria: a widget/unit test overrides analyticsServiceProvider with a fake, drives a tutor-session mark-complete attempt, and asserts logEvent(LogEvents.tutor.liveMarkBlocked) was called exactly once
